dbi-services:yugbytedb-on-oci-oke: Moving from RDBMS to NoSQL only reduces complexity when consistency requirements drop to single-item access, otherwise it shifts consistency work into application code instead.
dbi-services:see-you-on-polywork-an-new-: Having covered Oracle and other databases extensively since returning to dbi-services, the author departed to join Yugabyte as a developer advocate for its PostgreSQL-compatible distributed NewSQL database.
dbi-services:cloud-cli: Installing AWS, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle CLIs into a shared cloud directory, the AWS configure step favors text output over JSON because some AWS consoles have understated large consumed-capacity numbers.
dbi-services:amazon-rds-oracle-in-multit: Amazon RDS for Oracle can provision the database as a multitenant CDB named RDSCDB while letting you pick the PDB name, at the same license cost as the non-CDB edition.
dbi-services:postgresql-on-arm-oci: Compiling PostgreSQL 14 beta1 on an OCI Ampere ARM instance needed explicit CFLAGS=-march=armv8.2-a+fp16, since GCC 11's default outline-atomics detection failed with an unknown extension error.
dbi-services:oracle-oci-arm-free: Oracle Cloud's free tier added a 4 vCPU, 24GB RAM Ampere Altra ARM compute shape at 3.0GHz, always free like the two existing VMs, directly competing with AWS Graviton2's limited free trial.
dbi-services:postgresql-on-aws-graviton2: On AWS Graviton2, PostgreSQL only uses ARM v8.1 LSE atomic instructions when compiled with CFLAGS=-march=armv8-a+lse, since PostgreSQL's own configure script targets the older ARM v8 baseline by default.
dbi-services:el-carro-the-oracle-operato: Google's El Carro Kubernetes operator automates Oracle Database lifecycle operations, tested here by deploying the free Oracle XE 18c image through Cloud Shell with a single install script.
dbi-services:delphix-and-upgrading-the-c: Delphix's 'Upgrade' button only repoints its Oracle Home reference after a manual database upgrade, so reverting a refreshed clone to an older Oracle version needs an undocumented telnet console command.
dbi-services:an-example-of-ora-01152-fil: Reproducing ORA-01152 shows that RESETLOGS fails to open a database when a restored datafile's checkpoint predates the redo stream still required to bring it to a consistent state.
dbi-services:pass-a-variable-to-a-trigge: Because PostgreSQL lacks Oracle-style session context variables or package globals, passing the acting user's identity into an audit trigger requires a session-scoped workaround instead of a built-in mechanism.
dbi-services:dynamodb-vs-aurora-vocabula: Loading a 25GB RNA dataset into Aurora PostgreSQL shows a covering index redundantly stores extra columns to avoid heap access, while a partial index excludes rows to keep the index itself smaller.
dbi-services:k8s-on-windows-virtualbox: Running Minikube on Windows with the VirtualBox driver hosts a single-node Kubernetes cluster capable of scaling a real database's pods up and down while keeping it continuously available.
dbi-services:some-ai-in-oracle-sql_id: The Oracle SQL_ID hash generated for a query filtering EMP by JOB='PRESIDENT' on the SCOTT schema reproducibly comes out as 5c0tty145sddp, an odd resemblance to '5c0tt' in leetspeak.
dbi-services:should-cpu-intensive-logic-: Running a Python ROT13 loop a million times through psycopg2 against a 100000-row PostgreSQL table shows database-side processing avoids the round-trip and context-switch cost of moving data to an app tier.
dbi-services:ora-32635-not-a-single-cell: ORA-32635 in a MODEL clause query traced back to NLS_COMP=LINGUISTIC set at instance level; switching the session to NLS_COMP=BINARY resolved the single-cell-reference-predicate error.
dbi-services:foreign-keys-in-mysql-nosql: Testing MySQL 8.0.23 InnoDB foreign keys with sample countries and cities data shows an uncommitted parent-row update still blocks child-table DML, contradicting the claim that foreign keys don't scale.
dbi-services:oracle-testing-resource-man: Without setting cpu_count or a Resource Manager Plan, 32 concurrent PL/SQL loop sessions on a 16-thread VM run purely on CPU with zero Resource Manager wait shown by Tanel Poder's Snapper script.
dbi-services:a-vpc-is-a-private-cloud-in: A cloud VPC in AWS and Google, Virtual Network in Azure, or VCN in Oracle plays the role of on-premises VLANs and subnets, while services like S3 bypass this virtual network layer entirely.
dbi-services:linux-perf-top-basics-under: Running perf top on two identical C functions called at a 1:3 versus 2:3 ratio confirms the reported Overhead percentage reflects relative sampled CPU time between symbols, not raw call counts.
dbi-services:aws-postgresql-on-graviton2: Objdump analysis of a Graviton2-compiled PostgreSQL binary shows LSE atomic instructions such as aarch64_swp4_acq already appear in XLogInsert and buffer-lock code without any explicit ARM v8.1 CFLAGS.
Compiling PostgreSQL 14devel from community source on an m6gd.2xlarge Graviton2 instance versus an m5d.2xlarge x86_64 instance shows near-identical build time before running the PGIO benchmark.
dbi-services:delphix-a-glossary-to-get-s: Delphix's setup console runs a storage duration test before engine initialization and uses commands like ls, commit, and up on a keyboard layout where quote and equals keys sit on the numeric pad.
dbi-services:oracle-rolling-invalidate-w: Setting the hidden parameter _optimizer_invalidation_period to 15 seconds instead of the 5-hour default confirms DBA_TAB_STATS_HISTORY and cursor KSUGCTM timestamps drive Oracle's rolling cursor invalidation.
dbi-services:oracle-db-on-azure-with-mul: Running Oracle 19c on an Azure marketplace VM image requires manually fetching OPatch and Release Update binaries from Azure instance metadata tags before applying them through CustomData scripts.
dbi-services:grafana-sql-and-in-list-for: Grafana's multi-value template variable builds a SQL IN() list from user selections, requiring __value and __text column aliases so the dashboard shows country names while filtering by country_id.
dbi-services:postgresql-on-linux-what-is: Linux's free command reports shared_buffers pages twice, once as filesystem cache and once as shared memory, so a table cached in both shows roughly double the on-disk dataset size as 'cached'.
dbi-services:odasim: Oracle's free ODA Simulator, deployed from the Oracle Cloud Marketplace, uses Portainer over Docker so createOdaSimulatorContainer.sh can spin up HA or lite-class ODA containers for command-line practice.
dbi-services:google_insights: Google Cloud SQL Insights samples PostgreSQL wait events for CPU, I/O, and lock contention every minute with 7-day retention, mirroring the ASH sampling model long used by Oracle AWR and RDS Performance Insights.
dbi-services:19c-serverless-logon-trigge: Oracle's SESSION_SETTINGS clause inside a client connection string, such as (SESSION_SETTINGS=(optimizer_mode=first_rows_10)), applies ALTER SESSION parameters at connect time without needing a logon trigger.
dbi-services:pressure-stall-information-: Oracle Autonomous Linux ships a kernel compiled with PSI support but disabled by default, so enabling Pressure Stall Information requires adding psi=1 to the boot command line through a custom tuned profile.
dbi-services:google-spanner-sql-compatib: Google Cloud Spanner gained a NUMERIC data type since an earlier evaluation, improving SQL compatibility for a globally distributed relational database provisioned here through the gcloud command line.
dbi-services:optimizer-statistics-gather: Setting DBMS_STATS.SET_TABLE_PREFS('PUBLISH','FALSE') lets freshly gathered statistics stay pending without immediately affecting the optimizer, avoiding a sudden E-Rows versus A-Rows plan mismatch.
dbi-services:password-rolling-change-bef: Before 21c's Gradual Password Rollover feature, a proxy user with CONNECT THROUGH lets an application authenticate with a yearly-rotated credential while the actual schema owner's password stays unused.
dbi-services:dynamodb-scan-the-most-effi: Scanning a 5000-item DynamoDB table with a COUNT selection consumes only 6 RCU total, showing a full table Scan can cost less per item than issuing 5000 separate single-key GetItem calls.
dbi-services:oracle-spd-status-on-two-le: Bug 20311655 turns out to be expected behavior: a SQL Plan Directive reaches the HAS_STATS learning state and repeats a misestimate whenever extended statistics cannot resolve the correlated predicate.
dbi-services:efficiently-query-dba_exten: Rewriting a DBA_EXTENTS lookup to start from X$KCCFE and X$KTFBUE instead of DBA_SEGMENTS located a corrupt block's owning segment on a 900TB, 7000-datafile database in about one second.
dbi-services:amazon-aurora-calling-a-lam: Aurora MySQL's mysql.lambda_async() call lets a trigger invoke a Lambda function on any DML, so an unencapsulated AFTER UPDATE trigger risks firing unwanted notifications during bulk fixes or replication replay.
dbi-services:oracle-write-consistency-bu: A 2011 Oracle bug, still reproducible in 18c, lets two concurrent UPDATE statements dequeuing the same 5 oldest 'NEW' rows both end up updating the identical set instead of five distinct rows each.
dbi-services:recovery-in-the-%e2%98%81-w: Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL treats a 'backup' as only a restore point, so continuous WAL-based recovery to any moment since the last backup requires separately enabling point-in-time recovery.
dbi-services:aurora-serverless-v2-cpu: Aurora Serverless v2 preview scaled from 6 ACU at 14% CPU with one session to 32 ACU at 97% CPU with eight concurrent sessions, implying the engine underneath runs on roughly an 8 vCPU host.
dbi-services:aurora-serverless-v2-ram: Unlike Serverless v1's power-of-two scale-up that stops and restarts the instance, Aurora Serverless v2 preview resizes RAM and the buffer pool online in finer ACU increments without dropping connections.
dbi-services:database-announcements-at-r: AWS re:Invent 2020 introduced Babelfish for Aurora, Aurora Serverless v2, and Glue Elastic Views, alongside RDS Proxy connection pooling and Graviton2 processor support for RDS PostgreSQL and MySQL.
dbi-services:dynamodb-scan-pagination: A DynamoDB Scan over roughly 5.2MB of 5000 items with 1042-byte items consumes 128.5 RCU per eventually-consistent page, because each 1MB read unit is billed even when items only partly fill it.
dbi-services:cross-cloud-pmm-which-tcp-p: Monitoring an OCI Autonomous Linux instance from a Percona PMM server hosted on AWS requires opening the HTTPS port for the client exporter's traffic to cross between the two cloud providers.
dbi-services:dynamodb-partiql-part-ii-se: DynamoDB's PartiQL SELECT still resolves to GetItem, Query, or Scan depending on whether the WHERE clause has an equality predicate on the partition key, so the underlying physical cost is unchanged.
dbi-services:dynamodb-partiql-i: DynamoDB's new PartiQL INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, and DELETE syntax, tested here through the AWS CLI's execute-statement command, still stores single items with no joins and no multi-item ACID transactions.
dbi-services:aws-burstable-ec2-cloudwatc: A t2.micro EC2 instance's CloudWatch CPU Credit Balance drops from 32 minutes to zero during a sustained 100% CPU process, after which CPU Utilization throttles down to a roughly 20% baseline.
dbi-services:recovery-in-the-%e2%98%81-w: Oracle Autonomous Database's point-in-time recovery always creates a new cloned database from a chosen timestamp or backup instead of restoring in place, preserving the original database's later transactions.
dbi-services:aws-dynamodb-s3-oci-autonom: AWS's no-code DynamoDB-to-S3 export combined with Oracle Autonomous Database's external table support lets Oracle SQL query DynamoDB-exported JSON files directly from an S3-compatible object store.
dbi-services:postgresql-in-aws-clearing-: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL runs the same community-compiled PostgreSQL binaries you would build yourself on EC2, distinguishing it from Aurora, a separate proprietary storage engine sharing only the RDS family name.
dbi-services:key-value-access-always-sca: A 4TB Oracle table left unpurged for years and split across 30 million extents still performed acceptably for end users, because hash-partitioned key-value access scales independently of total data size.
dbi-services:what-is-a-database-backup-b: A logical export like pg_dump or Oracle expdp is not a database backup, because it alone cannot support point-in-time recovery to any moment between the last export and a later failure.
dbi-services:ycsb-nosql-benchmark-on-ora: The Yahoo Cloud Serving Benchmark, designed around a simple key-value get/put NoSQL workload generator, can also drive comparable load against Oracle Database through its extensible client interface.
dbi-services:cluster: RAC clusters multiple Oracle instances together for higher availability, referenced here only as a light analogy for a 2014 Oracle Open World dinner that gathered several long-time database community members.
dbi-services:oracle-adb-jupyter: Connecting a Google Colab Jupyter notebook to Oracle Autonomous Database on the Free Tier requires installing libaio1, the Instant Client, SQLcl, and a public-bucket wallet through wget and unzip commands.
dbi-services:oracle-maa-reference-archit: Oracle's Maximum Availability Architecture ranks Bronze (single instance with RMAN), Silver (RAC), Gold (RAC plus synchronous Data Guard), and Platinum (adding GoldenGate and sharding) by product combination.
dbi-services:amazon-aurora-serverless-po: Amazon Aurora Serverless supported only PostgreSQL 10.7 compatibility at the time, auto-pausing to zero capacity after 5 minutes idle and resuming through a VPC-only proxy endpoint with no public access.
dbi-services:amazon-or-aws-services: AWS names standalone customer-facing services 'Amazon', like DynamoDB and RDS, while utility services operating on them, like Backup or Database Migration Service, are named 'AWS' per community naming convention.
dbi-services:what-is-object-storage: Object storage exposes flat buckets of UUID-identified objects carrying rich metadata tags instead of a directory hierarchy, unlike the file and block-device model that databases traditionally read from.
dbi-services:aws-dynamodb-a-relational-g: In DynamoDB an Attribute is a JSON member with no fixed domain or length limit, unlike a relational column, and its partition plus optional sort key together replace a composite primary key's ordering role.
dbi-services:troubleshooting-autonomous-: Oracle Autonomous Database's Performance Hub drills ASH activity by Consumer Group, Wait Class, and Wait Event, isolating roughly 0.86 average active sessions attributed entirely to internal background processes.
dbi-services:data-virtualization-on-sql-: Redgate SQL Clone builds a detached 'Image' directly from a SQL Server .bak backup file, letting several thin clones share the same underlying data blocks instead of each restoring a full copy.
dbi-services:sql-server-on-oracle-cloud: Deploying SQL Server 2016 Standard from the Oracle Cloud Marketplace requires opening ingress ports 3389 for RDP and 1433 for the SQL Server listener, since it runs as an IaaS VM rather than a managed PaaS service.
dbi-services:oracle-adb-rename: Since August 2020, an Oracle Autonomous Database instance can be renamed, which changes the service_name embedded in the CONNECT_DATA entry that existing client wallets use to reach the underlying PDB.
dbi-services:aws-dynamodb-the-cost-of-in: Unlike Oracle's optimizer-chosen access paths, a DynamoDB secondary index is only used when the application explicitly queries it, and every table write still pays the cost of maintaining each index entry.
dbi-services:aws-dynamodb-local: DynamoDB Local, a downloadable offline version sharing the cloud service's API, lacks partitioning and appears to use a different storage format entirely, so it cannot be used to measure real performance.
dbi-services:rdbms-scales-the-algorithm: Comparing a hash-partitioned DynamoDB access pattern against an Oracle nested-loop index join on up to 2000 keys shows both scale predictably as matched rows per key grow, unlike the claim that RDBMS joins don't scale.
dbi-services:a-lesson-from-nosql-vs-rdbm: SQL, originally designed per Chamberlin's history as an accessible end-user query language, is now mostly generated by BI tools and ORM frameworks, which often produce suboptimal queries blamed on SQL itself.
dbi-services:myth-nosql-vs-rdbms-relatio: On Oracle's free Autonomous tier, Resource Manager caps CPU and I/O per service even for a SALES join to PRODUCTS, showing a relational call can be bounded like a NoSQL lookup.
dbi-services:a-serverless-standby-databa: Autonomous Data Guard replicates physical redo-applied datafile blocks to its standby rather than logical SQL statements, despite the announcement describing this software-level apply as 'logical changes'.
dbi-services:dbpod: The DBPod podcast launched with three Oracle-focused episodes covering database versioning between 19c and 20c, Release Updates, and the Multitenant option, distributed through Anchor, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts.
dbi-services:19c-scalable-top-n-queries: Oracle 19c fixes bug 22174392 so a query using FETCH FIRST n ROWS ONLY gets correct low cardinality row estimates without needing the FIRST_ROWS() hint that was previously required in 12c.
dbi-services:the-myth-of-nosql-vs-rdbms-: A query joining roughly 900,000 SALES rows to PRODUCTS on Oracle Autonomous Database returns in 92 milliseconds via a nested loop with index range scan, contradicting the claim that relational joins scale poorly.
dbi-services:oracle-acfs-du-df: Taking an Oracle ACFS snapshot means any block later modified in the parent or a child volume consumes additional storage, so the free space shown by 'df' can diverge from what a plain 'du' on the mount suggests.
dbi-services:al7: Oracle Autonomous Linux applies Ksplice kernel updates online without a reboot, configured here on an Always Free OCI compute instance through an API key generated with openssl and the al-config CLI tool.
dbi-services:oracle-ace-program: The Oracle ACE program tracks blog posts, talks, and forum activity through an accumulating points system entered in an APEX application, used to determine eligibility for a level upgrade rather than to rank members.
dbi-services:some-myths-about-postgresql: Contrary to a migration comparison guide, Oracle's closest equivalent to PostgreSQL foreign data wrappers is Database Gateway and Heterogeneous Services, and materialized views handle small reference-table distribution.
dbi-services:column-level-collate: Oracle 12.2's column-level COLLATE clause lets a VARCHAR2 primary key built from mixed letters and numbers sort in plain binary ASCII order through its index even when a linguistic NLS_SORT is set for the session.
dbi-services:oracle-12c-analytic-views: Oracle's Analytic Views hide multi-table joins and GROUP BY aggregation behind a single queryable object, giving BI users drill-down access to a snowflake schema hierarchy without writing explicit SQL joins.
dbi-services:oracle-12c-global-partial-i: A global partial index on COVID-19 case data lets Oracle skip index maintenance for the newest, frequently-loaded partition while still indexing older partitions that were reorganized and clustered by country.
dbi-services:oracle-12c-clustering: Using 12c's online ALTER TABLE MERGE PARTITIONS and online partition move together, a time-ordered ingest table can be periodically reorganized to cluster old rows by country instead of by arrival date.
dbi-services:oracle-row-pattern: Oracle's MATCH_RECOGNIZE row pattern matching detects peaks directly in a COVID-19 daily case time series using SQL, replacing what would otherwise be a manual visual scan of an Excel line chart.
dbi-services:oracle-index-on-joins: Oracle's Synchronous Refresh for Materialized Views, using REFRESH FAST ON STATEMENT, behaves like a pre-built join index by storing a dimension table's country_code alongside a fact table row automatically.
dbi-services:what-is-a-serverless-databa: A serverless database means server provisioning no longer sits on a project's critical path, contrasted here with a 1996 setup where obtaining and racking Oracle Database hardware took weeks.
dbi-services:oracle-select-from-file: Oracle 18c's Inline External Tables let SQLcl query a downloaded COVID-19 case-count CSV file directly with a SELECT statement, without first running SQL*Loader or creating a persistent external table object.
dbi-services:tibero-ii: Tibero's TPR (Tibero Performance Repository), tested here by running Kevin Closson's SLOB benchmark adapted from Oracle syntax, mirrors Oracle AWR reporting but is driven through the tbsql client instead of sqlplus.
dbi-services:oracle-standard-edition-on-: As of May 2020, Oracle Standard Edition 2 licensing on AWS counts every 4 vCPUs as one socket and requires at least 2 sockets per server regardless of whether hyper-threading is enabled.
dbi-services:always-free-always-up-tmux-: Comparing always-free compute tiers, only the Oracle Cloud free VM combines unlimited duration with full SSH access and a public IP, unlike Google Cloud Shell's no-SSH access or AWS's one-year time limit.
dbi-services:20c-awr-now-stores-explain-: Oracle 20c's AWR finally stores filter and access predicates for colored SQL statements, letting DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_AWR show them after bugs previously blocked Statspack and AWR from capturing predicates.
dbi-services:the-myth-of-nosql-vs-rdbms-: Adding a nullable column to an existing Oracle table only updates data dictionary metadata rather than every existing row, refuting the claim that adding an attribute is costlier in SQL than in a NoSQL JSON document.
dbi-services:aws-aurora-xactsync-batch-c: Aurora's IO:XactSync wait event, unlike a plain PostgreSQL commit-time WAL fsync wait, actually reflects Aurora's proprietary distributed storage layer write-durability protocol rather than a local disk sync.
dbi-services:tibero-i: TmaxSoft's Tibero database claims deep Oracle SQL and PL/SQL compatibility, evaluated here through a 30-day trial license whose activation key is tied to the output of 'uname -n' on the host running it.
dbi-services:oracle-support-easy-export-: DBMS_SQLDIAG.EXPORT_SQL_TESTCASE builds a complete reproducible test case, including a README and object dump, from just a SQL_ID pulled out of DBA_HIST_SQLTEXT, without manually gathering tables, stats, or parameters.
dbi-services:segment-maintenance-online-: An ALTER TABLE MOVE PARTITION with the ONLINE keyword on a basic-compressed partition sets a distinct online-compression flag bit in TABPART$, which alone triggers the Advanced Compression feature-usage counter.
dbi-services:find-the-sql-plan-baseline-: After a new index makes the optimizer prefer a different plan, that plan loads into the SQL Plan Baseline store as unaccepted, so DBA_SQL_PLAN_BASELINES must be searched by SQL_HANDLE to evolve or drop it.
dbi-services:dynamodb-covering-lsi: DynamoDB forces a Local Secondary Index to be declared when the table is created, so turning a partition-key-prefixed covering index into an LSI means rebuilding the table.
dbi-services:dynamodb-covering-gsi: Even when a DynamoDB table's primary key already filters items, adding a Global Secondary Index with a smaller projected attribute set reduces read cost for queries that only need that narrower attribute set.
dbi-services:ysql_bench: YugabyteDB's optimistic concurrency control triggers more serialization retries than PostgreSQL's pgbench natively handles, so a PL/pgSQL retry-wrapped procedure substitutes for pgbench's built-in simple-update script.
dbi-services:yugabytedb-2-1: YugabyteDB 2.1 GA fixed the slow pgbench initialization time seen in an earlier 1.3 beta and delivered roughly nine times higher pgbench throughput on the same 3-node, replication-factor-3 cluster.
dbi-services:refactoring-procedural-to-s: Refactoring the MySQL Sakila sample schema's rental logic shows translating procedural business rules into declarative SQL, instead of leaving them in stored-procedure loops, improves both performance and readability.
dbi-services:oracle-20c-sql-macros-a-sca: Oracle 20c scalar SQL Macros let a name-formatting function be inlined by the optimizer at compile time like a C preprocessor macro, avoiding the per-row SQL-to-PL/SQL context switch of a normal function call.
dbi-services:sqlnet-expire_time-and-enab: Since Oracle Net 12c, server-side Dead Connection Detection relies on TCP keep-alive instead of a TNS packet, and tracing connect() calls on both listener and client confirms when ENABLE=BROKEN is actually still needed.
dbi-services:how-sql-server-mvcc-compare: With READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT enabled, SQL Server 2019 still blocks a reader on an indexed column being updated, unlike PostgreSQL and Oracle where MVCC readers never wait on a writer's row lock.
dbi-services:running-sql-server-on-the-o: SQL Server's container binary refuses to start below 2000MB because sqlservr hardcodes that RAM check, so a sub-1GB Oracle Cloud free VM needs sysinfo() interception to fake memory.
dbi-services:rollback-to-savepoint: Unlike Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, and MySQL, PostgreSQL discards an entire transaction after any statement error, including a prior successful insert, unless an explicit SAVEPOINT was set before the failing statement.
dbi-services:a-tribute-to-natural-join: A NATURAL JOIN between EMP and DEPT breaks silently and returns zero rows once both tables independently gain a same-named LOC column, showing the risk lies in unprojected column names, not NATURAL JOIN itself.
dbi-services:the-size-of-oracle-home-fro: Running representative workloads against an Oracle 18c ORACLE_HOME and keeping only files actually touched showed the true footprint drops from 9GB, mostly libraries and patch storage, down to under 600MB.
dbi-services:oracle-database-on-openshif: After pulling an Oracle Database image from Docker Store, importing it into OpenShift's Image Stream on a MiniShift VM required raising the disk allocation to 40GB beyond MiniShift's 20GB default.
dbi-services:oracle_home-with-symbolic-l: Running postupgrade_fixups.sql fails with ORA-29283 when ORACLE_HOME is a symbolic link, because DBMS_PREUP's UTL_FILE call to the preupgrade_dir directory object cannot resolve the linked path correctly.
dbi-services:18c-runinstaller-silent: Oracle 18c's root-level runInstaller is a shell wrapper around Perl's dbSetup.pl, and calling it with -silent -executePrereqs checks OS prerequisites before installation without launching the Java GUI.
dbi-services:transport_connect_timeout-a: Without a virtual IP, a client address list failing over between two Data Guard hosts waits the full 60-second default TCP timeout per address unless TRANSPORT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT and RETRY_COUNT are set explicitly.
dbi-services:atp-vs-adw-the-autonomous-d: Oracle's ATP and ADW autonomous services run as PDBs inside the same CDB and differ mainly by their OLTP versus DWCS PDB lockdown profile, which enables the partitioning option only for the ATP profile.
dbi-services:merge-join-cartesian-a-join: Forcing the USE_MERGE_CARTESIAN hint on an EMP-DEPT join shows Oracle can implement an inner join by first computing a full Cartesian product and filtering afterward, classifying it as a join method, not a join type.
dbi-services:how-much-free-space-can-be-: DBMS_SPACE.SPACE_USAGE's FS1 through FS4 free-space buckets let a PL/SQL loop over DBA_SEGMENTS estimate a lower-bound reclaimable free space per ASSM segment without running a full segment shrink.
dbi-services:oracle-18c-preinstall-rpm-o: Since Oracle 18c, the database preinstall RPM installs cleanly on RHEL and its derivatives, not just Oracle Linux, resolving every Linux prerequisite dependency through a single yum localinstall command.
dbi-services:release-18-0-0-0-0-version-: Oracle 18c, the renamed 12cR2 patchset, appeared on OTN under the free developer license after Oracle Cloud stabilization, enabling version-matched on-prem binaries for 18.3 cloud databases.
dbi-services:installing-zfs-on-oel7-uek4: Using ZFS as a Docker storage driver on OEL7 with UEK4 requires installing matching kernel-uek-devel headers and DKMS first, since Docker's own documentation recommends ZFS for dense database-as-a-service workloads.
dbi-services:google-cloud-spanner-insert: Google Cloud Spanner's gcloud beta rows insert command handles only one row per invocation, so loading a million rows into a 3-node distributed instance required a shell loop, not bulk SQL.
dbi-services:google-cloud-spanner-no-dec: Google Cloud Spanner originally offered only INT64 and IEEE-754 FLOAT64 data types, so storing exact decimal values like prices in a FLOAT64 column introduces binary rounding error absent from an Oracle NUMBER column.
dbi-services:drilling-down-the-pgsentine: Grouping pg_active_session_history by backend_type over a 5-minute window and dividing the sample count by elapsed seconds derives an Average Active Sessions metric for PostgreSQL, matching Oracle's AAS from ASH.
dbi-services:pgsentinel-the-sampling-app: The pgSentinel extension samples pg_stat_activity into a queryable Active Session History table for PostgreSQL, exposing wait detail during a PGIO SLOB-style run that plain 'top -c' output cannot reveal.
dbi-services:data-guard-always-set-db_cr: Because db_file_name_convert changes require a Data Guard standby instance restart to take effect, setting the dynamic db_create_file_dest parameter instead lets unmatched new primary datafiles apply without downtime.
dbi-services:my-tmux-scripts-to-script-d: Tmux scripts and a customized vim configuration, published on GitHub, drive semi-interactive conference demos by mapping vim macros to tmux-send commands that replay script lines into a shared attached session.
dbi-services:18c-order-by-in-with-clause: When 12.2+ materializes a reused CTE into an In-Memory Cursor Duration Temp Table, ORDER BY inside the WITH clause no longer preserves row order across UNION ALL consumers, breaking ROWNUM logic.
dbi-services:18c-some-optimization-about: Updating 10,000 rows to the same uppercase value they already store produces about six times less redo than changing them to a new value, showing 18c still optimizes same-value UPDATEs.
dbi-services:event-sourcing-cqn-is-not-a: Oracle's Continuous Query Notification, built for refreshing caches on slowly changing data, is not designed for event-sourcing microservice architectures that need Change Data Capture for frequent transactional changes.
dbi-services:statspack-installation-scri: A published GitHub script set installs Statspack with its own tablespace, scheduled snapshot and purge jobs, a fix for idle-event noise, and a modified collection level for execution plans and segment statistics.
dbi-services:pgio-pg_stat_activity-and-p: Unlike Oracle's V$SESSION and V$SQL joined on SQL_ID, PostgreSQL's pg_stat_activity only shows the top-level PL/pgSQL call during a PGIO run, so pg_stat_statements must be enabled to see the actual executed statements.
dbi-services:lighty-for-postgresql: Orachrome's Lighty for PostgreSQL beta samples pg_stat_activity every 10 seconds into its own dedicated database, whose one-active-session average in its own dashboard is a sampling artifact rather than real overhead.
dbi-services:kernel-panic-not-syncing-ou: A misconfigured vm.nr_hugepages value allocating nearly all server RAM caused a 'Kernel panic: Out of memory and no killable processes' at boot, fixed temporarily by forcing mem=4g at the GRUB prompt.
dbi-services:18c-no-active-data-guard-re: Oracle 18c removes the Active Data Guard requirement for real-time-apply read-only opening of CDB$ROOT and PDB$SEED during online PDB cloning, as long as user PDBs stay closed while managed recovery applies changes.
dbi-services:introduction-to-database-fo: Teaching data modeling and SQL basics to refugee coding-academy students used MySQL 8.0.19 and PHP, a stack chosen to match the students' existing MAMP curriculum rather than the instructor's usual Oracle environment.
dbi-services:remote-syslog-from-linux-an: If SYSDBA auditing stays only in adump or the database trail, the DBA can erase it; forwarding Oracle audit records with rsyslog over TCP or UDP 514 to another host protects the evidence.
dbi-services:adwc-new-oci-interface: Switching Autonomous Data Warehouse to the OCI console silently invalidated old PSM bookmarks with a generic START_SERVICE failed message, forcing use of the new console URL and OCI CLI.
dbi-services:change-data-capture-from-or: StreamSets Data Collector's Oracle CDC origin, built on LogMiner rather than Oracle GoldenGate, streams changes through a Docker-deployed pipeline while inheriting LogMiner's datatype, DDL, and performance limitations.
dbi-services:installing-mamp-to-play-wit: Setting up MAMP with PHP and MySQL to load the OpenFlights open dataset for a database teaching exercise required disabling Apache's display_errors default before the first PHP scripts would run cleanly.
dbi-services:sqlcl-connect-target-depend: In SQLcl, a bare 'connect / as sysdba' after connecting through a service name attempts a bequeath login that can fail or, with a matching sys password elsewhere, silently reconnect you to the wrong database.
dbi-services:openshift-on-my-windows-10-: Installing MiniShift 1.18.0 on Windows 10 with the VirtualBox driver fails to locate the VM's files whenever the minishift.exe binary and the default Windows profile directory sit on different drive letters.
dbi-services:which-bitnami-service-to-ch: Running Kevin Closson's pgio SLOB method with four 1GB cached-only schemas across Bitnami PostgreSQL images on different Linux distributions isolates whether the kernel changes CPU throughput.
dbi-services:postgres-the-fsync-issue-an: PostgreSQL long relied on write() plus fsync() at checkpoints rather than O_DSYNC writes, which is why fsync error handling became a distinct risk in the long-running 'fsync issue' debate.
dbi-services:adwc-system-and-session-set: Autonomous Data Warehouse's DWCS lockdown profile blocks almost every ALTER SYSTEM except a small allowlist and ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION, which ADMIN can inspect in V$LOCKDOWN_RULES.
dbi-services:12c-upuserxt-lst-upobjxt-ls: Since Oracle 12c, users and objects created at database creation carry ORACLE_MAINTAINED='Y', which lets upuserxt.lst and upobjxt.lst separate system accounts from application ones before upgrade.
dbi-services:adwc-connect-from-your-prem: SQLcl's thin JDBC driver can connect to Autonomous Data Warehouse directly from the downloaded wallet zip via 'set cloudconfig', unlike SQL Developer's Cloud PDB flow, which expects it unzipped.
dbi-services:sql-developer-web-on-the-or: SQL Developer Web on Oracle DBaaS worked only after Cloud Tooling was patched to the required dbaascli version as root, because the feature was announced before the tooling caught up.
dbi-services:some-ideas-about-oracle-dat: Faster Oracle Database Docker builds come from isolating the multi-GB install zip and yum prerequisites into cached intermediate layers, so later builds avoid resending the heavy context.
dbi-services:adwc-the-hidden-gem-zepplin: Autonomous Data Warehouse's 'Manage Oracle ML Users' menu creates OML_DEVELOPER-role accounts needed to open the Apache-Zeppelin-based Oracle Machine Learning SQL Notebooks, separate from the regular ADMIN login.
dbi-services:adwc-a-docker-container-to-: An Alpine container can install the PSM CLI and trap signals around 'psm ADWC start-service' and 'stop-service', so Autonomous Data Warehouse starts and stops without storing credentials in scripts.
dbi-services:adwc-startstop-with-psm-com: Though undocumented, PSM's ADWC start-service, stop-service, and restart-service commands exist in the CLI's own help output and are the fastest way to control Autonomous Data Warehouse billing by the hour.
dbi-services:adwc-creation-of-autonomous: Choosing Bring-Your-Own-License when creating an Autonomous Data Warehouse instance drops the price from $2.50 to $0.48 per OCPU-hour, and stopping the service between connections avoids paying for idle compute time.
dbi-services:covering-indexes-in-oracle-: Oracle lacks SQL Server's INCLUDE clause, so adding covering columns means appending them to the key itself, which changes clustering factor and branch block size because the full entry is sorted.
dbi-services:after-iot-iop-makes-its-way: Querying V$SQLFN_METADATA in Oracle 18c on the Oracle Cloud reveals an undocumented TO_DOG_YEAR SQL function tagged version V13, alongside newer JSON_MERGEPATCH and ROUND_TIES_TO_EVEN function entries.
dbi-services:docker-efficiently-building: Testing add, copy, rename, and append Dockerfile steps on an XFS-backed Docker daemon shows each RUN layer preserves prior file states, so a removed or renamed 100MB file still consumes image layer space.
dbi-services:docker-ce-on-oracle-enterpr: On Oracle Linux 7.4, the ol7_addons repository only offers the six-month-old docker-engine 17.06 package, so installing the actively updated Docker CE 17.12 requires adding CentOS's docker-ce repository instead.
dbi-services:result-cache-invalidation-c: A DELETE statement matching zero rows still invalidates a dependent Oracle Result Cache entry, because the statement still acquires a Row Exclusive TM-mode lock declaring intent to modify that table.
dbi-services:18c-pdb-switchover: Oracle 18c's PDB-level switchover, built on refreshable PDBs, failed with ORA-46697 when mandatory TDE encryption was enabled on the source CDB, since 'alter pluggable database' offers no keystore-password option for it.
dbi-services:enabled-accepted-fixed-sql-: Testing 8 index-cost variations against a SQL Plan Baseline confirms Oracle only executes the currently Accepted plan among Enabled ones, ignoring cheaper newly loaded plans until they are manually accepted or fixed.
dbi-services:18c-new-lost-write-protecti: Oracle 18c introduces a standalone Lost Write Protection tablespace that stores per-block SCNs to detect a silently dropped disk write, without needing a Data Guard standby as the earlier 11g mechanism did.
dbi-services:18c-dbms_xplan-note-about-f: Since Oracle 18c, DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_CURSOR adds an explicit note when the optimizer failed to use a SQL Plan Baseline for a statement, after a data model change made the originally accepted plan unreproducible.
dbi-services:18c-cloud-first-and-cloud-o: Oracle 18c's alert.log logs 'capabilities requested' versus 'detected' entries, revealing that some new features check for Oracle Cloud or Engineered Systems platform capabilities and never run identically on-premises.
dbi-services:a-free-persistent-google-cl: Google Cloud Shell's persistent home directory with 5GB storage lets Oracle Database XE 11gR2 survive between sessions on its free VM, installed by splitting the RPM zip file to work around the shell's upload size limit.
dbi-services:pdb-upgrade-from-12c-to-18c: Unplugging a 12.2.0.1 PDB and plugging it into an 18.1 CDB still takes as long to upgrade the PDB dictionary as upgrading CDB$ROOT itself, despite the reduced metadata expected from multitenant's metadata-link design.
dbi-services:oda-lite-what-is-this-odacl: ODA Lite's odacli configuration and operations are stored in an embedded Apache Derby database at /opt/oracle/dcs/repo, readable offline through SQuirreL SQL Client's JDBC driver once the DCS agent is stopped.
dbi-services:18c-read-only-oracle-home: Oracle 18c's roohctl -enable moved beyond the old orabasetab flag: it relocates mutable config, logs, and database files outside the immutable Oracle Home, which fits container image usage.
dbi-services:description_listdescription: strace on failed connect() calls shows DESCRIPTION_LIST load balancing randomly rotates between DESCRIPTION entries, while an ADDRESS_LIST inside one DESCRIPTION walks addresses in another order.
dbi-services:full-page-logging-in-postgr: With full_page_writes=on, PostgreSQL logs the whole 8KB page the first time it is dirtied after a checkpoint, behaving like Oracle begin-backup mode rather than normal Oracle redo.
dbi-services:vmystat-delta-values: A pair of generated SQL scripts capture V$MYSTAT statistic deltas between two points in a session and display them as one labeled row instead of requiring two separate queries and a manual subtraction.
dbi-services:server-process-name-in-post: Oracle background processes all appear as the generic 'oracle' executable in ps, while PostgreSQL exposes each backend's database, client address, and active command directly in its process title.
dbi-services:12cr2-pdb-archive: An October 2017 Release Update fixes 12.2's PDB Archive feature, a zipped XML descriptor plus datafiles for PDB transport, so it now also works when the PDB's datafiles reside on ASM instead of only a regular filesystem.
dbi-services:jan18-database-11gr2-psu-12: Oracle patch terminology differs by release: 11.2.0.4 uses a PSU, 12.1.0.2 recommends a Proactive Bundle Patch over its plain PSU, and 12.2.0.1 uses a Release Update, all traced to My Oracle Support Doc ID 756671.1.
dbi-services:multitenant-pdb-save-state-: Connecting through a PDB's own name as its default service, instead of a custom service, breaks down once a standby database registers the identically-named PDB service to the same listener as the primary.
dbi-services:result-cache-when-not-to-us: Result Cache pays off for repeated calls with the same argument; using many distinct IDs instead creates contention, and DML invalidation makes each miss more expensive than the uncached path.
dbi-services:testing-oracle-sql-online: SQL Fiddle, Rextester, db<>fiddle, and Oracle Live SQL run free online Oracle instances limited to the older free 11gR2 XE version, because only freely licensed Oracle software can legally back a shared public service.
dbi-services:explain-plan-format: DBMS_XPLAN's format string groups columns under BASIC, TYPICAL, ALL, and ADVANCED levels, and options like 'allstats last' add per-execution row and buffer statistics on top of the default typical plan display.
dbi-services:unplug-an-encrypted-pdb-ora: Unplugging a TDE-encrypted PDB that raises ORA-46680 requires first exporting the PDB's own master key from V$ENCRYPTION_KEYS while it is open, since only the CDB-level wallet key gets exported automatically.
dbi-services:spectre-and-meltdown-on-ora: Disabling KPTI, IBRS, and IBPB mitigations on Oracle Cloud UEK gives only about 5% higher single-session SLOB logical reads, but the gain becomes more visible once two or more concurrent SLOB sessions run together.
dbi-services:spectremeltdown-on-oracle-p: Against the logical-read expectation, SLOB tests on Oracle Cloud UEK showed higher physical-read IOPS with Spectre/Meltdown KPTI enabled than with nopti, across several concurrency levels.
dbi-services:spectre-and-meltdown-oracle: Comparing SLOB cached-read CPU performance on an AWS M4.xlarge instance before and after Amazon applied Spectre and Meltdown microcode patches shows little degradation for a workload with no heavy system-call activity.
dbi-services:keep-your-orapw-password-fi: Giving a schema user read access to the ORACLE_HOME/dbs directory object lets that user BFILE-read the orapw password file and reuse its hash for remote authentication without knowing the password.
dbi-services:12c-multitenant-internals-p: When a common-user DDL statement fails on a closed PDB, Oracle records the failure in PDB_PLUG_IN_VIOLATIONS rather than blocking the CDB$ROOT change, then replays the DDL against that PDB the next time it opens.
Common users, roles, and profiles created in CDB$ROOT are copied to each PDB by replaying DDL from PDB_SYNC$, not by metadata links, and Oracle tracks progress with a per-container REPLAY#.
dbi-services:drop-pdb-including-datafile: Dropping a PDB with INCLUDING DATAFILES can leave its datafile inodes open by parallel background processes from an earlier plug-in step, so filesystem space is not reclaimed until those processes close the file handles.
dbi-services:12cr2-subquery-elimination: Oracle 12cR2 adds Subquery Elimination, removing an EXISTS or IN semi-join subquery, and its extra full table scan, whenever the optimizer proves the subquery reads the same table with no filtering predicate.
dbi-services:oracle-docker-image-from-do: Oracle Database images from Docker Store needed only a one-time OTN license acceptance in the Store UI, replacing the older model of distributing sealed installation media.
dbi-services:impdp-logtimeall-metricsy-a: With LOGTIME=ALL and METRICS=Y, impdp timestamps each completed object type and reports per-worker counts, making it clear 12cR2 can process metadata such as TABLE objects in parallel.
dbi-services:12c-multitenant-internals-c: Tracing ALTER PACKAGE DBMS_SYSTEM COMPILE from a PDB shows Oracle switches to CDB$ROOT to read SOURCE$, yet some system DDL issued from a PDB is silently reduced to a no-op.
dbi-services:unstructed-vs-structured: Tracing DBMS_BACKUP_RESTORE.REFRESHAGEDFILES in the recovery area exposed an archivelog deletion policy bug: swapping 'BACKED UP ... TIMES TO' and 'APPLIED' changes what Oracle reclaims.
dbi-services:cbo-first_rows-and-view-mis: A FIRST_ROWS(10) query against a view containing an ORDER BY, wrapped in a subquery calling a PL/SQL function, ended up calling that function for a million rows instead of ten after a migration from 10g to 12c.
dbi-services:dynamic-sampling-vs-extende: With optimizer_dynamic_sampling=4 and adaptive stats off, a case-insensitive UPPER() filter underestimated rows in a large table and pushed the optimizer toward an expensive nested-loop plan.
dbi-services:multitenant-internals-int-a: Oracle's doubled INT$INT$ dictionary views, such as INT$INT$DBA_CONSTRAINTS, merge CDB$ROOT and PDB data transparently for common views, layered on top of the simpler single INT$ extended-data-view mechanism.
dbi-services:multitenant-dictionary-what: Contrary to Oracle documentation stating Oracle-supplied objects live only in the root, system PL/SQL package source is root-only via metadata links, but system table definitions like COL$ are replicated into every PDB.
dbi-services:quick-history-on-database-g: Joining DBA_HIST_SEG_STAT to DBA_HIST_SEG_STAT_OBJ, even in Standard Edition without Diagnostic Pack, flags segments whose hourly growth exceeds 1% of database size so abnormal expansion stands out.
dbi-services:dbvisit-replicate-sql-devel: A custom SQL Developer chart report queries DBVREP.DBRSCOMMON_LAG_STATS to plot Dbvisit Replicate's MINE-to-APPLY replication lag in minutes over time, visualizing a deliberately introduced replication stop.
